fact: The February 2024 terms of reference state that the SIGEC diagnostic is carried out under component 1 of PROGOUV, a project of 8 million euros for which the Mairie de Djibouti is contracting authority with Expertise France's technical assistance, and that a budgeted action plan for improving and securing SIGEC is one of the mission's deliverables, to be drawn up within the means of the Mairie and the communes.
title: Diagnostic du système informatisé de gestion de l'état civil (SIGEC) de la Ville de Djibouti — Termes de Référence
publisher: Projet d'appui à la gouvernance de la Ville de Djibouti (PROGOUV) / Expertise France
